rows.transcript_1:
Close your eyes. 

Take a minute to think about the day.

Think about one positive or fun thing you did.
Praise yourself for one thing you did well today. 
Think of one thing you can do differently tomorrow.  
Think of one thing that you are grateful for.
rows.transcript_2:
Tutup mata anda.

Luangkan satu minit untuk memikirkan tentang hari ini.

Fikirkan satu perkara positif atau menyeronokkan yang anda lakukan.
Puji diri anda untuk satu perkara yang anda lakukan dengan baik hari ini.
Fikirkan satu perkara yang anda boleh lakukan dengan cara berbeza esok.
Fikirkan satu perkara yang membuatkan anda rasa bersyukur.
rows.title: Think about today

text_1.eng: Being a great parent also means taking time to care for yourself every day. It starts with recognising how you feel.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng: So good to hear you are feeling well today. You are incredible!

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng: We all have days where we just don’t know. That is okay! You are here and that is what matters.

quiz_1_feedback_3.eng: Being a parent can be hard. But you are here and that shows you want to keep improving things. That is a big accomplishment already!

text_1_facilitator.eng:
Today is about learning what to do when our children misbehave. 🚩 

It is normal for children to misbehave when they are tired, scared, hungry, learning independence, wanting something, or avoiding a task. 😒😔😣

One thing you can do is to stop it before it starts. This is called redirecting behaviours.

text_2.eng:
Redirecting behaviours can help focus your child’s attention from negative to positive behaviours. 😣➡️😃

For example, when your child begins to whine, you can redirect their attention towards something positive like helping out with an activity. 🌱🎨

text_1_facilitator.eng: But what if children are already misbehaving? Can you still redirect their behaviour at that point?

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: You can use redirect at any time, even when your child is already behaving badly like having a tantrum.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

➡️ Redirecting your child’s behaviour only works either before the behaviour begins or at the beginning of the behaviour (before it gets worse).

🙂 You will learn about what we can do if your child is already misbehaving in the next 2 skills.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ There are four steps to redirecting behaviour: BE CALM, QUICK, CLEAR, and POSITIVE.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 4️⃣ There are four steps to redirecting behaviour: BE CALM, QUICK, CLEAR, and POSITIVE.

section_1_text.eng:
✅ Take a few breaths before asking your child to do something else.
✅ Speak with a calm voice.

section_2_text.eng:
2️⃣ BE QUICK

⏰ Ask your child to do something else, distract them, before the behaviour begins or gets worse.
💡 This is much easier than using consequences after they do something!

section_3_text.eng:
✅ Rather than saying what you DON’T like or want, tell your child what you DO want them to do.
For example, say:
👂 “Please speak more softly.”
🍚 “Remember to wash your hands after eating.”
This way, it is easier for them to follow! ⭐

section_4_text.eng:
💚 Use positive words. Say “Come and help me plant these vegetables,” instead of saying, “Stop fighting.”
⭐ Praise your child when they behave well!
💙 It will also help them know what you expect from them!
